baselineBehavior: Original index.html had duplicate class attributes on reset buttons, and lacked regression tests distinguishing broken choice click handlers from correct behavior.
changedBehavior: Corrected duplicate HTML class attributes and added word wrapping. Implemented regression test distinguishing unmutated working state from a deliberate click-binding mutation.

deliberateMutation.description: Deliberately suppressed choice click event dispatch in a temporary test context.
deliberateMutation.intendedFailureReason: Click event binding broken: #example-element style does not update upon choice click.
